title: campanula americana var. illinoensis
intro: Campanula americana var. illinoensis, commonly known as American bellflower, is a flowering plant species in the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of American bellflower include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and support immune function. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
